execution.fill_policy: Next open with synthetic entry_executable=true within 2 bars. Flag false at index modulo 29 in {10,11}. Fixed entry notional; no queue, impact, borrow, funding, market capacity or intrabar equity guarantee.
execution.gap_policy: Opening gap beyond stop/target exits at actual open before intrabar tests; otherwise single trigger at level; both triggers ambiguous bounds; time exit at final holding close. Continuous stops/targets and guaranteed exit liquidity are synthetic assumptions, NOT production guarantees.
execution.horizon_policy: Fixed 10-bar label availability window; 12-bar opportunity stride prevents position overlap. Close-marked risk path, lower-bound ambiguous scenario, initial-equity denominator.

inference.opportunity_comparison: Explicit confirmed zero exposure for NO_SIGNAL and NO_FILL, with distinct counts; ambiguity never zero. Paired and full-population block bootstrap are descriptive, uncalibrated. One instrument, no sector-diversity claim.

regimes: Generator regime labels are diagnostic truth only, never strategy inputs or a validated live regime detector.

signal_definitions.mean_reversion: (mean(close[t-lookback:t])-close[t])/population_std(close[t-lookback:t]) > threshold; zero standard deviation => no signal

timing: Synthetic minute candle final at minute-end minus one microsecond; available/decision at that instant; next open strictly later. Simulated availability, not audited historical receipt.
